label: GO: confident repeat of a1 after a common rewarded a1 trial (mid-episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), only when the previous trial was rewarded via a common transition after choosing a1 (never after a2, rare, or unrewarded previous trials; prev unknown on a window first trial is allowed), and only when the policy strongly favors a1 (all activations have choice logit > 8.07, top ~10% of steps; virtually all are a1 choices / stays). It is also confined to episode trials ~10-59 (zero after trial ~65), an absolute-time dependence, and to high-but-not-max value (7.5-8.1). Predicate uses only observed history plus the agent own policy output. Recall/mass recall ~0.95 but precision only ~0.24: the unit is a graded a1-win-stay signal that crosses threshold on just a subset of matching steps; what selects that subset was not found (value, streaks did not help much). Magnitude not clearly modulated by any tested variable.
